title: Tofu Coconut Curry with Spinach, Tomatoes, Cilantro & Rice

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the bowl with the ginger and garlic (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Medium dice tofu and place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and thinly slice shallots crosswise. Add to the bowl with the tofu, along with salt and pepper, and gently toss to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu mixture to the skillet (reserve bowl for the next step) and cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is browned and slightly crispy, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tofu to a plate (reserve skillet for later use).
While the tofu cooks, roughly chop spinach; halve tomatoes. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, cilantro, curry powder, and turmeric; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Juice lime into the skillet, then add coconut milk, broth, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low, return cooked tofu, and stir to combine.

Add spinach and tomatoes to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the veggies to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook until veggies are soft and tofu is heated through, about 3 minutes.
To serve, divide rice and tofu curry between bowls. Top with reserved cilantro and enjoy!
